## Summary

Describe the observable change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour.
- [ ] `pnpm release:check` passes.
- [ ] Visual changes include appropriate image or video evidence.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated where required.
- [ ] No credentials, private repository URLs, or customer data are included.

## Evidence

List commands, revisions, screenshots, recordings, or other deterministic proof.
